note: Cases reuse the programs of the icon-format goldens. The vocabulary step feeds a 16-icon Lucide subset; the expected findings are the Rust icon.rs behaviour (validate_icon_value, find_similar_icons) computed on that subset and equal to `orb validate --json` on the real set for the parity fixtures. Rust orders equal-similarity suggestions by HashSet iteration, so the atom orders ties by vocabulary position.
